answer: The comparator took 318 ps at ss/-40C: the 2 um tail M0 and the 4 um input pair discharge xp and xn slowly, so the latch starts late. With M0, M1 and M2 at 8/0.13 um the evaluation current and gm of the pair are about four and two times larger, and check_specs passes at all 15 corners: both decisions are full swing, the reset holds 1.2 V, and the slowest decision is 194 ps at ss/-40C.
